summary: A treasurer can report the campaign office closed while a utility refund is still due.
realLife: Garcia reported that the Mercado Mall election headquarters had closed and its bills were paid, with a refund still expected from the electric company (December 3, 2016).
inGame: needs: the office closing, final bills and refundable deposit.

turns.what: The treasurer posts the receipt against the deposit.
turns.pulledBy: The utility sends the refund after the final bill.
turns.writesBack: The closed office has no outstanding utility balance.

turns.what: The treasurer follows up using the closed account number.
turns.pulledBy: The next statement arrives without the refund.
turns.writesBack: The report lists the deposit as money still due.
